en: A colorized vintage postcard view of a coastal hillside settlement along the Bosphorus. Numerous low-rise buildings line the waterfront and climb the slope, with a larger institutional-looking building set higher on the hill. The foreground shows the calm waters of the strait, and the background features green hills under a pastel sky. Printed captions appear at the top in Latin characters and another script, and a website watermark is visible at the bottom right.
